tools.name: track_report
tools.description: Legacy deterministic backlog projection. JSON/text/Markdown outputs are compatibility reads and never invoke AI; use track_snapshot for the canonical factual contract and CLI `track report --wp --decisions` for the complete local conductor.

baselineCommit.description: Commit the report is evaluated against (acceptance/staleness).

requireAccepted.description: A done item counts as DONE only if acceptance=pass.

decisions.description: Include the decisions view (defaults on for text/md, off for json).

format.description: Legacy deterministic render format. Default json; text/md remain frozen compatibility diagnostics.

tools.name: track_snapshot
tools.description: Canonical deterministic Track snapshot. Provider-free factual state only; never invokes AI and never represents a human interpretation.

requireAccepted.description: A done item counts as DONE only if acceptance=pass.

tools.name: track_query
tools.description: Flat, filtered query over the non-decision report rows, as JSON.

tools.name: track_validate
tools.description: Recompute the append-only integrity chain (detect-only). Returns {ok, findings}. NOTE: integrity only — unlike the CLI `validate`, it does NOT include prose↔log desync (that would read arbitrary cwd files, breaking the read-only contract).

tools.name: track_audit
tools.description: DESIGN R4 — deterministic structural audit over the folded log, as JSON AuditFinding[] (orphan, empty-wp, duplicate, cross-workspace-subtree, singleton-workspace). PURE, read-only, no clock; byte-identical to the CLI `audit --format json`. `severity` action=resolve via the restructuration plan flow, info=expected/structural.

tools.name: track_branch_provenance
tools.description: Latest branch.imported provenance for a BRANCH.md locator (or null).

tools.name: track_freshness
tools.description: Is the sidecar structurally current with the given BRANCH.md content for a locator?

tools.name: track_external_deps
tools.description: Open external (scope:extra) dependencies awaiting an h2a ENGAGEMENT, as JSON [{blockerId, targetId, engagementRef, openedAt}]. What an h2a bridge watches to resolve when an engagement settles.

tools.name: track_status
tools.description: status(level) projection (Scope §A/§B): rolls leaf buckets up to a scope tier {spec|plan|wp|lot|task}, as JSON {level, groups:[{id,title,label,depth,status,done,active,dropped,pct}]}. wp ≡ the computeWpTree forest; task = leaf buckets; lot|plan|spec = the same rollup over WP-nesting tiers (SUM not mean; dropped excluded; 0/0⇒n/a). Read-only.

level.description: The scope tier to roll up to.

requireAccepted.description: A done leaf counts as DONE only if acceptance=pass.

tools.name: track_verification_runs
tools.description: Recorded path-scope VerificationRuns (Scope §B(c)) — the EVIDENCE a future `scope validate` reads, as JSON [{runId,runner,commit,env?,verdict,wpRef?,violations?,at}]. EVIDENCE-ONLY: a path verdict never becomes an item. `violations` are the harness verbatim offending paths (track never glob-matches). Optional `wpRef` filters to one WP/phase.

wpRef.description: Filter to runs for this WP/phase item id.

tools.name: track_scope_validate
tools.description: Scope §B(b) — PURE, read-only, fail-closed, ADVISORY scope validation, as JSON {status:pass|fail|stale|missing, findings[], perWp[], scopeRevisionHash?}. NEVER glob-matches (string-level set logic), NEVER ingests, NEVER a commit gate. Flags scope-undeclared / incoherent (allowed∩forbidden) / illegal-nesting / claim-out-of-phase, and surfaces the latest ingested VerificationRun verdict per WP (read, never recomputed). If `content`+`locator` are supplied, requireFresh runs FIRST (a stale/altered/not-imported sidecar ⇒ status:stale, no partial verdict). Optional opt-in inferDeliveredOutOfScope.

workspace.description: The workspace whose WP/spec-phase scope is validated.

content.description: Live BRANCH.md content for the fail-closed freshness gate (with locator).

locator.description: BRANCH.md locator for the fail-closed freshness gate (with content).

claimedItemId.description: Optional claimed item id — flagged if not a descendant of a declared phase.

inferDeliveredOutOfScope.description: Opt-in: flag a done WP whose latest verification is a violation (a read flag).

tools.name: track_cursor
tools.description: M5 (canevas) — a cheap change cursor over the log tail, as JSON {head, count}. `head` = the log-tail event contentHash (null when empty); `count` = the event count. O(tail). The host's liveness primitive: poll this, re-read track_canevas / track_amendment_trace when it moves. Read-only.

tools.name: track_canevas
tools.description: M5 (canevas) — the materialized canevas for ONE workspace, as JSON {workspace, report, prov, affordances, dossier?}. report = the bucketed report + WP rollup forest (workspace-scoped); prov = per-aggregate latest-write provenance lineage {origin:human|machine, …}; affordances = per-aggregate legal next WorkEvent kinds (open-action affordances). With `decisionId`, also includes the full decision dossier. PURE (no clock, no socket — the host owns liveness).

workspace.description: The workspace to materialize the canevas for.

requireAccepted.description: A done leaf counts as DONE only if acceptance=pass.

decisionId.description: Optional decision id — includes its full dossier (context/options/qa/outcome/artifacts).

tools.name: track_amendment_trace
tools.description: M5 (canevas) — the human/machine diff for ONE aggregate, as JSON [{seq, at, by, kind, prov, origin, summary?, patchRef?, proposalRef?, selectedOptionId?}]. An ordered (by seq), prov-tagged projection over the aggregate's spec.amended / dossier.revised / decision.artifact-added / decision.option-selected / decision.outcome events. `origin` derives PURELY from prov.proposed (true=machine, false=human). An AI proposal + a human acceptance both appear — the machine origin is never laundered. PURE replay.

aggregateId.description: The item/decision aggregate id to trace.

tools.name: track_workspace_activity
tools.description: Poll-able activity signal for ONE workspace (h2a conductor-launch gating), as JSON {workspace, pending, pendingItems[], stalled[], latestEventAt?}. PURE: the caller supplies `now` (and optional `idleMs`, default 24h) — track holds no clock. `pending` = TO-DO+AWAITED count and `pendingItems` lists the concrete open leaves; `stalled` = items/decisions durably stuck (awaited-open-blocker | pending-decision | in-progress-idle | todo-idle).

workspace.description: The workspace to scope the signal to.

now.description: Caller-supplied ISO-8601 "current" time (track holds no clock).
